ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var downstream = error.errorMessage.payload var errId = error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN" var code = error.errorMessage.attributes.statusCode default ( if (errId == "BAD_REQUEST") 400 else if (errId == "NOT_FOUND") 404 else if (errId == "CONFLICT") 409 else if (errId == "BAD_GATEWAY") 502 else if (errId == "TIMEOUT" or errId == "CONNECTIVITY") 503 else 500 ) --- if (downstream != null and downstream.error != null) downstream else { "success": false, "error": { "code": if (code == 404) "PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND" else if (code == 409) "INSUFFICIENT_STOCK" else if (code == 400) "VALIDATION_ERROR" else if (code == 503) "DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE" else "INTERNAL_ERROR", "message": error.description default "Error al comunicar con Retail Orders Process API", "httpStatus": code, "correlationId": vars.correlationId default correlationId } }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var errId = error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN" --- error.errorMessage.attributes.statusCode default ( if (errId == "BAD_REQUEST") 400 else if (errId == "NOT_FOUND") 404 else if (errId == "CONFLICT") 409 else if (errId == "BAD_GATEWAY") 502 else if (errId == "TIMEOUT" or errId == "CONNECTIVITY") 503 else 500 )
